# <span id="aanchor363"></span> Location Editor

Use the Location Editor to create logical groups of meters and/or locations for specific time periods. Locations are especially useful for summing multiple meter tubes and performing system balancing.

Once a location is created, the Location Rollups service creates hourly, daily, and monthly records for the location by totaling volume, energy, and mass, and averaging fields like pressure, temperature, and analysis. All meters and locations under a parent location are totaled to the parent location.

When creating a new location you must select a fluid phase ("Gas" or "Liquid"). This is done by clicking the arrow on the right side of the New button. If you just click the New button, rather than the drop-down, the fluid phase for the location will be based on the default fuid phase defined in [User Preferences](../../Settings%20Manager/User%20Settings/User%20Preferences.md).

The selected fluid phase does not affect which data is rolled up or calculated at the location level. All data is calculated and rolled up the same way, regardless of Fluid Phase. The location’s fluid phase only affects how the Meter/Location Rollup Viewer initially displays the location. If you select "Gas", the location will initially display with the Measured tab selected. If you select "Liquid", then the location will initially display with the Liquid Flow Data tab selected. Some tabs displayed in the Meter/Location Rollups Viewer will also vary depending on which fluid phase is selected.

All location types (except station locations) require the **System Balancing Functions** module.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Location Editor: 

Go to **Setup** \> **Location** \> **Location Editor**.

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

Use the panes on the lower half of the Location Editor screen to add or modify members of a location. The radio buttons at the top left pane provide a list of all available meters or locations. The right pane lists the current members of the location. Add or remove a member from the location by clicking the member and using the arrow buttons.

The following items are available in the Location Editor:

- **System** - FLOWCAL system associated with the location.

- **Location** - Location number. The location number cannot contain any of the following symbols: (&, \|, \<, \>, ^). Spaces will be converted to underscores.

- **Name** - Location name. Non-unique, optional identifier for each location. It has a 50-character maximum. Location name is not datetime effective.

- **Type** - Station, Segment, Balance, or Inventory. See: [About Locations](../About%20Locations.md)

- **Active Status** - Indicates whether a location is active or disconnected and is determined by the status of the meter members. The status is datetime effective and is split based on the status changes of its members during the meter rollup process.

- **Reference Meter** - Used to ensure common pressure base, temperature base, contract hour and contract day for all meters in a location. This field is required to create a new Location.

- **From/To** - Locations have a Time Span (start and end datetime) which represents the time frame each set of members should be included with the location. In the To field, the latest date can be entered by pressing **Ctrl+E**; in the From field, the earliest date can be entered by pressing **Ctrl+S**. The end date must occur later than the start date.

- **Rollups** - Location rollups may be controlled per location.
  - **Enabled** - Locations are set to Enabled by default. The location will automatically roll up every time an edit is made.
  - **On Demand** - Selecting the On Demand option allows the user to declare when the Location will roll up. Clicking the On Demand button on the Unrolled Locations tab of the Service Queues screen makes these records visible and updates the status of these entries to "In Queue".
  - **Disabled** - If a location is set to Disabled, then it will not be rolled up. Disabled is useful if the location totals are not needed, but the organizational hierarchy of locations is still helpful.

- **Root Location** - The Root Location check box is used to indicate that a location is at the top of a balance hierarchy. Other locations can be placed in it as members, as well as meters. A Root Location cannot be added as a member of another location without having Root Location unchecked.

- **Find** - Launch a text box for data entry to quickly search through the grid. You can also press **Ctrl+F**.

- **Refresh** - Reload the location from the database

- **Security** - View or edit users that have access to the location.

  User/group access to the location is only relevant for companies that maintain object level security. Most companies do not restrict access at the object level.

- **Delete** - Deletes a location.

- **Edit** - Enter Edit mode to edit a selected location.

- **New** - Create a new location.

When you click the **New** button, the fluid phase is set to the user-defined default fluid phase configured within User Preferences. To set the fluid phase manually, click the drop-down on the **New** button and select Gas or Liquid.

- **Exit** - Close the Location Editor.
- **Query** - Open the [Query Editor](../../Tools/Query%20Editor.md) to populate the Location based on a query.

To add members based on a query, the user must run the query from the Query Editor and select the members from the Query Results by clicking the right arrow button.

- **Save** - Save changes.
- **Cancel** - Cancel changes.

</div>
